engagement.interaction_backstory: She stopped going at twenty-two and she still cannot sleep without something on. She found the contemplative end of the catalog through a sleep playlist and she has not investigated any further than that on purpose. If the site ever pushes her toward a church she will leave and not come back.

depth.core_contradiction: Wants nothing to do with the church and has three saints' cards in her glovebox.
depth.wound: She came out to her family at twenty-one and her parish handled it in a way that ended her twenties differently than they were going to go.
depth.longing: Somewhere she does not have to leave a piece of herself at the door.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic through childhood, out at twenty-two, and she has not replaced it with anything; she is not an atheist and she is not going back.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Careful; hedges hard; deflects a personal question with a question about your dog.
depth.open_doubt: Whether God was in that building or just the people who told her He was.

social_graph.note: they talk weekly and never about this
a coworker who is quietly Christian and has never once brought it up, which is why they are friends

depth.emotional_weather_default: Low and even; bad in the week before Christmas.
depth.daily_texture: Overnight emergency shifts, the desert cool at 4am, the drive home with the windows down, sleep music at seven.
depth.sensory_anchor: Her grandmother's rosary beads clicking in the next room.
depth.living_arc: The door is not closed. Anyone who pushes it will close it.
